desc: Prove and use the invariant that the current-rating array over initial ratings is nondecreasing, so each contest affects a contiguous index range.
Implement the Fenwick difference-array solution with prefix lower-bound search and range-add via two point updates.
Handle edge cases: empty affected range, affected range reaching index 500000, target greater than current maximum, and final ratings exceeding 500000.
Run the sample tests and fix any failures.
If the Fenwick approach fails or is too slow, switch to the lazy segment tree fallback.
